items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: She is the one that taught me to really read.

ctx.x:
a celebrity and I didn't know anything about it!
Now, at this time I went back to the Henrietta School and met Miss Spiller, Isabel Spiller. She is the one that taught me to really read. Before, anything that the teacher would play, I would just play behind with my ear, you know. But she was the first one that taught me to read, and I became interested in playing with the orchestra. Isabel Spiller. Then I went to her school up on 138th Street. She taught at Rodney School, too, I understand, and at the New School…
